description: Implementation of MojoRendererFactory class for creating various types of media renderers in Chromium project, including default, media foundation, cast, flinging, and media player renderers.

classes.name: MojoRendererFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating different types of MojoRenderer instances based on platform and build flags.

methods.name: CreateRenderer
methods.description: Creates a default MojoRenderer with specified task runners and sinks.

methods.name: CreateMediaFoundationRenderer
methods.description: Creates a MediaFoundation-specific MojoRenderer on Windows.

methods.name: CreateCastRenderer
methods.description: Creates a Cast-specific MojoRenderer if cast rendering is enabled.

methods.name: CreateFlingingRenderer
methods.description: Creates a flinging renderer for Android platform.

methods.name: CreateMediaPlayerRenderer
methods.description: Creates a media player renderer for Android platform.
